info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: The Direct Debit Mandate Management API allows businesses to update trade banking information for direct debit mandates using specific parameters. This operation primarily interacts with financial records and parameters that define banking mandates, enabling users to ensure accurate and efficient management of their direct debit processes. Common consumers of this API include financial institutions and businesses managing direct payments. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their banking operations and maintain up-to-date mandate information.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific direct debit mandate identified by its resource ID. Ensure all necessary information is provided to successfully process the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the Direct Debit Mandate details for RES-100045. It consists of the necessary fields that need to be modified according to the user's request.
